shortDescription: Indian Navy Agniveer SSR & MR INET 2026 result is available for the 01/2027 and 02/2027 batches. Candidates can check the official portal for result and next-stage call-letter updates.
content:
Indian Navy has released the Agniveer SSR & MR INET 2026 result for the 01/2027 and 02/2027 batches.

Eligible candidates should use the official candidate login to check the result and download the Stage II call letter or other available admit-card documents.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 14/03/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 06/04/2026
  • Stage I INET Exam: 13/05/2026 to 15/05/2026
  • Admit Card Available: 05/05/2026
  • Result Available: 17/09/2026
